job_description:
Consultant (Software Developer) needed for Dexian, LLC located in McLean, Virginia. Will perform DevOps tasks. Configure automated deployments and pipelines to implement continuous delivery into all testing and production environments. Design, implement, and support development, test production environment deployment automation, respond to and troubleshoot deployment issues, inform/advise application stakeholders. Will use Ansible, Jenkins, XL Release, JFrog Artifactory, Atlassian, Bitbucket, Kubernetes, and Open Shift. Will provide services to clients located throughout the US. Will be assigned to unanticipated client sites located throughout the US and subject to travel/relocation. Must have a bachelor's degree ln computer science, information technology or engineering and 5 years of overall progressive experience in DevOps which includes at least 2 yrs. of exp. in the skill sets listed in the job description. Must be willing to travel/relocate. Send resumes to:

Dexian stands at the forefront of Talent + Technology solutions with a presence spanning more than 70 locations worldwide and a team exceeding 10,000 professionals. As one of the largest technology and professional staffing companies and one of the largest minority-owned staffing companies in the United States, Dexian combines over 30 years of industry expertise with cutting-edge technologies to deliver comprehensive global services and support.  
 
Dexian connects the right talent and the right technology with the right organizations to deliver trajectory-changing results that help everyone achieve their ambitions and goals. To learn more, please visit https://dexian.com/.

Dexian is an Equal Opportunity Employer that recruits and hires qualified candidates without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.
